sections.title: Find the connection ports
sections.excerpt: Find the connection ports | Each node has handles on its edges: input handles on the left of non-launch screens, and one output handle per action on the right. Hover a handle to see its action label.

sections.title: Draw a default connection
sections.excerpt: Draw a default connection | Drag from an output handle on the source to an input handle on the target to create an edge. This is an unconditional path: every visitor who takes that action goes to the target.

sections.title: Remove a connection
sections.excerpt: Remove a connection | Click an edge, then Delete Connection and confirm. The target becomes unreachable through that action unless another path exists.

sections.title: Add conditions to a connection
sections.excerpt: Add conditions to a connection | Click an edge to open Connection Details, then Edit Conditions to define AND/OR logic on flow variables. Conditional paths activate only when the conditions are true.

sections.title: FlexibleLayout sections add their own handles
sections.excerpt: FlexibleLayout sections add their own handles | FlexibleLayout screens hold multiple sections (content, buttons, options, embeds, paywalls), and each can generate its own connection handles. Handles appear automatically based on the sections you add.

sections.title: Carousel and ProgressSteps auto-advance
sections.excerpt: Carousel and ProgressSteps auto-advance | Carousel and ProgressSteps screens advance on a timer rather than a button, so their timer handle is what you route from. These types have no Action Bar because visitors do not click Continue.

sections.title: Verify the flow is complete
sections.excerpt: Verify the flow is complete | Before publishing, confirm a launch screen is set, every non-final screen has an outgoing connection, paywall screens point to valid products, and each branch ends meaningfully.
